cards.ex: The project timeline is subject to change depending on funding.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning muddati moliyalashtirishga qarab o'zgarishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa kelajakda o'zgarishi ehtimoli borligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: The investigation was conducted in accordance with established protocols.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv belgilangan protokollarga muvofiq o'tkazildi.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga yoki ko'rsatmalarga to'liq mos kelishini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The current draft leaves much to be desired in terms of clarity.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi loyiha aniqlik nuqtai nazaridan yaxshilanishga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yetarlicha yaxshi emas, ko'proq harakat talab etiladi.

cards.ex: The proposed tax increase remains a point of contention among lawmakers.
cards.exUz: Taklif etilayotgan soliqning oshishi qonunchilar o'rtasida bahs nuqtasi bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Munozaraga sabab bo'ladigan masalani bildiradi.

cards.ex: On the flip side, the new policy could also create unintended consequences.
cards.exUz: Boshqa tomondan, yangi siyosat kutilmagan oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaziyatning qarama-qarshi tomonini ko'rsatadi.

cards.ex: After years of research, their efforts finally came to fruition.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik tadqiqotlardan so'ng, ularning sa'y-harakatlari nihoyat amalga oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki maqsad muvaffaqiyatli bajarilganligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: In the grand scheme of things, this is a minor setback.
cards.exUz: Umumiy manzarda qaraganda, bu kichik bir to'siqdir.
cards.term: in the grand scheme of things
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq, kengroq nuqtai nazardan qaraganda.

cards.ex: The study challenges the underpinning assumption that economic growth always benefits everyone.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot iqtisodiy o'sish har doim hammaga foyda keltiradi, degan asosiy taxminga qarshi chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror nazariyaning yoki argumentning asosi bo'lgan taxmin.

cards.ex: This proposal flies in the face of established environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Bu taklif belgilangan ekologik qoidalarga qarshi chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy qabul qilingan fikrga yoki odatlarga qarshi borish.

cards.ex: The study was conducted in conjunction with several international research institutions.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot bir nechta xalqaro ilmiy-tadqiqot muassasalari bilan birgalikda o'tkazildi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda yoki hamkorlikda amalga oshiriladigan narsa.

cards.ex: He made a statement to the effect that he would resign if the allegations were true.
cards.exUz: U agar ayblovlar rost bo'lsa, iste'foga chiqishini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning umumiy mazmunini yoki ta'sirini bildirish.

cards.ex: The company receives the lion's share of government funding for research.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya tadqiqot uchun hukumat moliyalashtirishining asosiy qismini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta yoki eng muhim qismi.

cards.ex: Allowing exceptions in this case could set a slippery slope for future decisions.
cards.exUz: Bu holatda istisnolarga yo'l qo'yish kelajakdagi qarorlar uchun sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat boshqa salbiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkinligi.

cards.ex: In the same vein, we need to consider the ethical implications.
cards.exUz: Shu kabi, biz axloqiy oqibatlarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash usulda yoki mavzuda.

cards.ex: The investigators left no stone unturned in their search for the truth.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruvchilar haqiqatni izlashda harakatdan to'xtamadilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani topish yoki yechim topish uchun hamma narsani qilish.

cards.ex: Be that as it may, we still need to find a solution to this problem.
cards.exUz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, biz hali ham ushbu muammoga yechim topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Avval aytilgan narsaga qaramasdan, deyish.

cards.ex: The proposals run the gamut from minor adjustments to radical reforms.
cards.exUz: Takliflar kichik tuzatishlardan tortib to tub islohotlargacha bo'lgan hamma narsani qamrab oladi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq diapazonni yoki spektri qamrab olmoq.

cards.ex: It's better to err on the side of caution when dealing with sensitive data.
cards.exUz: Maxfiy ma'lumotlar bilan ishlayotganda ehtiyotkorlikka ustunlik bergan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Xavfsizlik yoki ehtiyotkorlikni afzal ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: In light of the fact that the evidence is inconclusive, we need to proceed carefully.
cards.exUz: Dalillar to'liq emasligini hisobga olgan holda, biz ehtiyotkorlik bilan harakat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Faktni hisobga olgan holda, sababga ko'ra.

cards.ex: The new findings call into question the validity of the previous research.
cards.exUz: Yangi topilmalar avvalgi tadqiqotning to'g'riligini shubha ostiga qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning haqiqiyligiga yoki to'g'riligiga shubha bildirish.

cards.ex: By way of introduction, let me briefly explain the project's goals.
cards.exUz: Kirish sifatida, loyihaning maqsadlarini qisqacha tushuntirib beray.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani etkazish yoki qilish usuli.

cards.ex: At the end of the day, what matters is that we achieve our objectives.
cards.exUz: Oxir oqibatda, maqsadlarimizga erishishimiz muhim.
cards.term: at the end of the day
cards.uzDef: Yakuniy xulosa yoki eng muhim narsa.

cards.ex: The negotiation process is fraught with danger and could easily collapse.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar jarayoni xavfga to'la va osonlikcha buzilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta xavf yoki muammolar bilan to'la.

cards.ex: In retrospect, we should have taken a different approach.
cards.exUz: O'tmishga nazar tashlasak, biz boshqa yo'l tutishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga qaraganda, keyinroq anglab yetganda.

cards.ex: To all intents and purposes, the project is now complete.
cards.exUz: De-fakto, loyiha endi yakunlangan.
cards.uzDef: Aslida yoki amalda.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the report argues for stricter regulations.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, hisobot qat'iyroq qoidalarni yoqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq tarzda xulosa qilib aytganda.

cards.ex: We should clarify the situation, lest it be said we were hiding something.
cards.exUz: Biz vaziyatni aniqlashtirishimiz kerak, aks holda biz bir narsani yashirayotganimizni aytishadi.
cards.uzDef: Shunday bo'lmasligi uchun, shunday deyishmasligi uchun.

cards.ex: The property has some issues, so caveat emptor applies in this situation.
cards.exUz: Mulkiy masalada muammolar bor, shuning uchun bu vaziyatda xaridor ehtiyot bo'lsin.
cards.uzDef: Xaridor o'zi xarid qilayotgan narsani diqqat bilan tekshirishi kerak.

cards.ex: The company's modus operandi involves aggressive marketing tactics.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning ish uslubi tajovuzkor marketing taktikasini o'z ichiga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kimsaning yoki tashkilotning ish usuli.

cards.ex: His controversial speech sowed the seeds of discontent among the population.
cards.exUz: Uning bahsli nutqi aholi orasida norozilik urug'ini sepdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda sodir bo'ladigan narsaning boshlanishiga sabab bo'lmoq.
